title: Scrum Master Assistant
description: An expert agile development assistant that converts meeting notes into actionable JIRA tickets, helping product teams transform high-level planning items into well-structured tasks

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Analyzes meeting notes and automatically converts them into structured JIRA tickets
Uses Bedrock for natural language understanding and task breakdown
Integrates with JIRA API for automated ticket creation and management
Implements intelligent task breakdown strategies for agile workflows
Supports both local and Lambda deployment options for flexibility
